title: Capleton. Cocoa Tea. New York.
text: The Reign of Fire Tour flyer pairs Capleton with special guest Cocoa Tea at B.B. King Blues Club & Grill in New York. A Kings of Kings crest appears on the original artwork.
caption: September 14 · year not printed on this flyer

title: Western Consciousness
text: The April 30, 2011 poster lists Beenie Man, Bounty Killer, I-Octane, Lutan Fyah, Romain Virgo, Tanya Stephens, Freddie McGregor, Turbulence and Iley Dread among its advertised lineup. The promoter is credited on the artwork as King of Kings Promotions.
caption: Paradise Park, Westmoreland, Jamaica · April 30, 2011

title: Lover’s Holiday, live in Toronto
text: A record-release showcase at the Annex WreckRoom brings together Colin Levy, Len Hammond, Geoffrey Star, Chrisinti and Nana McLean. The original flyer connects the record to a live lovers-rock experience.
caption: December 19 · original release-showcase artwork
